paper_title: Adaptive Resource Scheduling in Cloud-Edge Environments Using Deep RL
authors: Zhang, L., Patel, R., Kumar, S.
abstract: We introduce a deep reinforcement learning framework that dynamically optimizes CPU and memory allocation, reducing energy overhead by 34% across distributed clusters.

paper_title: Carbon-Aware Computing: Measuring and Minimizing Datacenter Power Spikes
abstract: Analysis of telemetry data from 50 enterprise datacenters showing methods to shift non-critical background computational jobs to off-peak renewable energy hours.

paper_title: Workload Balancing and Developer Burnout Prediction via VCS Telemetry
abstract: An empirical study tracking commit frequencies and pull request reviews to predict engineering fatigue and balance issue distribution.
